description: Create a new monitor. Use 'website' for a page that should return 200, 'rest_endpoint' for an API endpoint (supports JSONPath assertions on the response body), 'ping' for ICMP, 'tcp' for a raw port, 'dns' for record drift, 'domain' for registration expiry, and 'heartbeat' for cron jobs that call in. Check the plan's minCheckIntervalMinutes via get_account before setting check_frequency_minutes.

check_frequency_minutes.description: Minutes between checks. Must be >= the plan's minCheckIntervalMinutes.

expected_status_codes.description: Status codes treated as healthy. Defaults to 2xx.

record_types.description: DNS record types to baseline (type 'dns' only)

request_body.description: JSON request body for POST/PUT/PATCH rest_endpoint checks

request_headers.description: Extra request headers. Do not put secrets here that you would not paste into a dashboard.

response_time_limit_ms.description: Fail the check if it responds slower than this

response_validation.description: Body assertions — this is what turns a 200 into a real health check.

expectedValue.description: Value the JSONPath result is compared against

url.description: URL to monitor. For 'dns' and 'domain' pass a bare domain. Omit for 'heartbeat'.

name: create_check
title: Create check
